description: Trazado de la Línea 1 del Metro de Bogotá is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa Metro de Bogotá S.A. - EMB. Es el recorrido horizontal que siguen las líneas del metro de Bogotá D.C. Los tramos pueden ser elevados o subterráneos En Bogotá D.C. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa Metro de Bogotá S.A. - EMB. Its tags are infraestructura de transporte, metro de bogota, transporte. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
